```yaml
name: Push Kubernetes Manifests to OCI Registry

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'overlays/x86/**'

jobs:
  push-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Push manifests to GHCR
        run: |
          # Get the current git commit hash
          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          
          # Push each manifest as an OCI artifact
          find overlays/x86 -name "*.yaml" -type f | while read -r manifest; do
            MANIFEST_NAME=$(basename "$manifest" .yaml)
            echo "Pushing $MANIFEST_NAME..."
            
            # Create a temporary directory for the manifest
            mkdir -p /tmp/manifests
            
            # Copy the manifest to temp directory
            cp "$manifest" /tmp/manifests/
            
            # Push to GHCR as OCI artifact
            skopeo copy \
              dir:/tmp/manifests \
              oci:ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/${MANIFEST_NAME}:${COMMIT_HASH}
          done
          
          # Clean up
          rm -rf /tmp/manifests

      - name: Update manifest index
        run: |
          # Create an index file with all manifest references
          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          INDEX_FILE="manifests-index-${COMMIT_HASH}.txt"
          
          echo "Manifests pushed at commit ${COMMIT_HASH}:" > "$INDEX_FILE"
          find overlays/x86 -name "*.yaml" -type f | while read -r manifest; do
            MANIFEST_NAME=$(basename "$manifest" .yaml)
            echo "- ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/${MANIFEST_NAME}:${COMMIT_HASH}" >> "$INDEX_FILE"
          done
          
          # Commit and push the index file
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add "$INDEX_FILE"
          git commit -m "Update manifest index for commit ${COMMIT_HASH}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD || echo "No changes to push"

      - name: Notify Slack (optional)
        if: always()
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/slack-report@main
        with:
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          slack_webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
